subject.title: feat: align native macOS chat with the web chat capability set

question: Should assistant reasoning and tool traces become visible by default for existing users in the full native macOS chat window?
rationale: The branch replaces a previously hard-disabled surface with a new persisted preference whose default is on; automated tests cannot determine the intended upgrade UX or disclosure policy.

options.title: Default on
options.body: Keep web-chat parity and document that existing users will see assistant traces unless they disable the preference.

options.title: Default off
options.body: Preserve the existing macOS upgrade experience while allowing users to enable assistant traces explicitly.

options.title: Defer trace behavior
options.body: Land the remaining parity features while holding the trace preference for a narrower product decision.

recommendation.title: Default on
recommendation.body: Keep web-chat parity and document that existing users will see assistant traces unless they disable the preference.

likelyOwner.reason: The protected maintainer signal and direct ownership of this product change make this person the strongest available decision route.
